svg.title: gbrain database — simple view
svg.desc: Four tables: pages at the center, with chunks, graph_edges, and jobs all pointing to it. Key columns shown for each.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the pages table store in gbrain?')
sendPrompt('What does the chunks table store and why?')
sendPrompt('What does the graph_edges table store in gbrain?')
sendPrompt('What does the jobs table do in gbrain?')

svg.text: Every table points back to pages. Pages is the source of truth.
chunks breaks pages into searchable pieces with vectors.
graph_edges connects pages to each other. jobs runs background work per page.
